intro.name: The finalists
intro.text:
Today is the last day of the annual Cooking Contest! After many grueling weeks, (cook1) and (cook2) have emerged victorious against many promising competitors. Now they just have to satisfy the judges in order to win the title of Culinary Champion.
(Cook1) is {A.1} {B}. (Cook2) is {A.2} {B2}.
(Cook1)'s biggest strength is {C}, while (cook2)'s is {C2}. (Cook1)'s biggest weakness is {F}, while (cook2)'s is {F2}. The judges like how (cook1) prefers {DC} cuisine. Compared to (cook2), they believe (cook1)'s cooking style is {DS}. Overall, (cook1) seems to be {G}.

ready.name: The basket
ready.text: (Cook1) and (cook2) are ready to face off. They have the whole day to whip up {H}, using whatever ingredients they may find around the island. The competitors have only five minutes to plan out their recipes before the competition starts. Each also receives a basket containing one required ingredient, which MUST appear in the finished dish. \(Required ingredient: {ING}.\)

workstation.name: The workstation
workstation.text: (Cook1) sees their workstation and spots baskets of staple ingredients as well as some oddities. (cook1.He/She) has a particular recipe in mind, but is not sure whether to stick with it, or try something new.

stick.text: (Cook1) decides not to risk it and goes for the safe option. This dish has been loved by many, and (cook1.he/she) knows nothing else can compare to it. (cook1.He/She) quickly gathers the ingredients, {I} {into|onto} {J.1}. Then (cook1.he/she) {L} the {K} into a {J.2} to serve to the judges. (Cook1) seems {M} about (cook1.his/her) creation.

new.text: (Cook1) decides that (cook1.his/her) initial recipe is too safe. To win a competition of this caliber, (cook1.he/she) needs to reach deep within and cook the most extraordinary dish Isola has ever seen! (cook1.He/She) quickly gathers the ingredients, {I} {into|onto} {J.1}. Then (cook1.he/she) {L} the {K} into a {J.2} to serve to the judges. (Cook1) seems {M} about (cook1.his/her) creation.

bell.name: The bell
bell.text: Finally, the bell tolls to signal the end of the cook-off. (Cook1) and (cook2) carefully place their dishes on the judges' table, and hope for the best.

end_a.text: After only a short deliberation, there is a clear answer.

win1.name: Cook one wins
win1.text: (Cook1) beats (cook2) in the culinary contest! The judges laud (cook1.him/her) for {O}. (cook1.He/She) is unmatched and is crowned Culinary Champion of Isola! Now, (cook1.he/she) {P}. (Cook2) {Q}. Your village gains (award) food.

win2.name: Cook two wins
win2.text: (Cook2) beats (cook1) in the culinary contest! The judges laud (cook2.him/her) for {O}. (cook2.He/She) is unmatched and is crowned Culinary Champion of Isola! Now, (cook2.he/she) {P2}. (Cook1) {Q2}. Your village gains (award) food.

end_c.text: At first, the judges go to pick (cook1) as the winner. They are impressed by (cook1.his/her) {O}. However, some time after, {a few|some|all} of the judges get {a terrible stomachache|mild stomach discomfort|all-out food poisoning|severe food poisoning}.

inv1.text: The cook accidentally used contaminated water. A cracked water vessel had been left near the latrines, and no one thought to check it. The healers order the water thrown out, the vessels cleaned, and the contestants retrained in food safety.

inv2.text: The judges were already feeling ill that day. A few had sensitive stomachs, and one had eaten far too much before the contest. The food was innocent!

text_only.reason: the cause of the illness, told; no stored food changes

inv3.text: The ingredients had spoiled in the heat while everyone was arguing over the rules. Neither competitor realized anything was wrong until it was too late.

inv4.text: An unwashed utensil had been used for raw {fish|meat|vegetables|shellfish} and then for ready-to-eat food. The healers discover the mistake and explain why cleanliness matters.

text_only.reason: the cause of the illness, told; no stored food changes

inv5.text: The food had been kept out for too long before judging, and the warm weather did the rest.

text_only.reason: the cause of the illness, told; no stored food changes

inv6.text: A peculiar Isolan mushroom was mistaken for an ordinary edible one. It was not deadly, but it certainly did not agree with the judges!

inv7.text: The judges accidentally sampled a healer's extremely {bitter|potent} medicinal concoction instead of the sauce. No wonder their stomachs rebelled!

inv8.text: A mischievous child had swapped the judges' drinking water for an experimental coconut-and-herb potion. The child is promptly sent back to class.

inv9.text: A tiny frog had taken up residence inside a serving vessel. The horrified judges decide that perhaps they have seen enough cooking for one day.

inv10.text: The healers find convincing evidence that someone deliberately contaminated the dish. The judges confront the culprit.
